class.name: CgameShaderStallAnalyzer
class.brief_description: Correlates frame-time spikes with pipeline compilation.
class.description: [CgameShaderStallAnalyzer] decides which slow frames were caused by shader/pipeline compilation and ranks the materials that were first drawn in those frames. A frame is a spike when it takes longer than the larger of [code]baseline * spike_factor[/code] and [code]baseline + min_extra_ms[/code], where the baseline is the median frame time. Spikes without compilations are reported as unrelated. Frames can be fed manually with [method feed] and [method feed_cumulative], or sampled natively: after [method start_auto_sampling] the engine reads the [RenderingServer] pipeline compilation counters and the frame time once per main loop iteration. Report newly drawn materials with [method note_material].

method.name: analyze
method.description: Returns [code]{baseline_ms, stalls, unrelated_spikes, culprits}[/code]. Each stall has [code]index[/code], [code]ms[/code], [code]extra_ms[/code], [code]compiles[/code] and [code]culprits[/code]; each culprit has [code]material[/code], [code]stalls[/code] and [code]total_extra_ms[/code], sorted by total extra time.

method.name: baseline_ms
method.description: Returns the median frame time in milliseconds.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all recorded frames and pending materials.

method.name: feed
method.description: Records a frame. [param compiles] is the number of pipelines compiled during it.

method.name: feed_cumulative
method.description: Like [method feed], but takes a cumulative compilation counter and computes the per-frame delta. The first call establishes the baseline.

method.name: frame_count
method.description: Returns the number of recorded frames.

method.name: is_auto_sampling
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while native per-frame sampling is active.

method.name: live_compile_total
method.description: Returns the sum of the [RenderingServer] pipeline compilation counters, or [code]0[/code] when no rendering server exists.

method.name: note_material
method.description: Records a material that was first drawn this frame. The next automatic sample consumes it. Safe to call from any thread.

method.name: start_auto_sampling
method.description: Starts sampling compilation counters and frame time at the end of every main loop iteration.

method.name: stop_auto_sampling
method.description: Stops native sampling. It also stops when the analyzer is freed.

members.member: Maximum number of frames kept while sampling automatically.
Minimum frame time above the baseline for a spike.
Frame times above the baseline multiplied by this factor are spikes.
